titles.notes: Source of title: Doris Bry label.
titles.title: Black Lines

description: Vertical watercolor on paper of very simple calligraphic black thin lines. There is a thick stroke along the bottom edge, with two delicate lines growing out. The one on the right traverses across the page through the middle to the top. The other on the left follows closely parallel up the page till the middle, where it makes a backwards N shape off to the left.
